why: This is a named, adapted questionnaire instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: 63-item medical leadership competencies questionnaire (adapted from Wagner et al. by Çitaku et al.)
product_description: A 63-item self-report assessment adapted by Çitaku et al. from Wagner et al.'s leadership-competency scale to measure physician-leaders' perceived importance of competencies across five medical-leadership domains.
